label: Вовсе
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вовсе (at all), usually in вовсе не.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Emphatic negation. 'Вовсе' almost always pairs with 'не' to mean not at all. Here 'вовсе не' strengthens the denial of 'устал', insisting the speaker is not tired in the least.
Strategic focus: Denying a degree. 'Вовсе не' negates 'трудно' emphatically, meaning not difficult at all. The pair stands before the word and rejects the quality completely.

missions.phrase: Он вовсе не хотел тебя обидеть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Strong denial of intent. 'Вовсе не' before 'хотел' insists he did not at all want to offend. The construction reassures and forcefully rejects the assumption.
Strategic focus: Clearing of blame. 'Вовсе не' negates 'виновата', meaning not guilty at all. The emphatic pair stands before the predicate and firmly defends the person.

missions.phrase: Я вовсе не это имел в виду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Correcting a misunderstanding. 'Вовсе не' before 'это' stresses that the speaker meant nothing of the sort. It is a common, emphatic way to reject a wrong interpretation.
Strategic focus: Rejecting a judgement. 'Вовсе не' negates 'плохая', meaning not bad at all. The pair stands before the adjective and turns away a negative assessment of the weather.

missions.phrase: Это вовсе не значит, что я согласен.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Denying an implication. 'Вовсе не' before 'значит' insists that something does not mean what was assumed. The construction is emphatic and common in argument.
Strategic focus: Denying a state. 'Вовсе не' negates the predicate 'скучно', meaning not bored at all. The pair stands before the word and rejects the feeling completely.

missions.phrase: Он вовсе не такой, как ты думаешь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Contradicting an image. 'Вовсе не' before 'такой' insists he is not at all as imagined. The emphatic pair sets up a firm correction of someone's view.

missions.phrase: Я вовсе не против твоей идеи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Denying opposition. 'Вовсе не' negates 'против', meaning not at all opposed. The construction reassures the listener and rejects any suggestion of objection.
